name: qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_bc

pin_regs.reason: Explicit RTL pin registers: every functional input (reload, epoch_go, halt, bcfg_*) is captured once at the pin and every output is a tile output register (one stage after the sequencer; the inner anchor runs EP_SKEW-2 so the epoch-anchored outputs keep the pin tile edges). A generic extra stage would shift the compiled calendar.

job.purpose: KV link calendar sequencer with the boot cfg merged (KV-DCAL-BOOTCFG 10-19): boot target 11 loads the link-end tables + SEG2 bases through bcfg_*; the MU sequencer (ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq_dies_mu.sv) keeps writing the runtime segment-1 bases (SEG1 after admission, SEG2 at each epoch) -- on the die today those writes were load-less, so every KV token run replayed the admission segment. One output register stage on every output (inner anchor EP_SKEW-2: epoch-anchored outputs on the pin-tile edges); sticky faults collision / boot-while-running / stale SEG2 / start-before-boot-base. Static, no credits.

structural_change: Admission-geometry recovery after bc1 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN before global placement (no route ran). Measured synthesis standard-cell area 265 um2 needs >=481.82 um2 core for <=55%; grow 18.792x34.56 to 21.6x34.56: core 17.28x30.24=522.5472 um2, measured utilisation 50.7%, aspect 1.60. Same registered boot/runtime cfg architecture and static schedule; no latency added.

safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: merge = 2:1 mux + 32-bit equality (stale) + 6-bit decode per stage, the sequencer logic unchanged (ep3/_mu closed at 770 ps route)
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: PASS: images are compile-time constants / boot words on the link end; no runtime-indexed flop arrays, no delay lines
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS: no macros; full std-cell band in 21.6x34.56 outline, aspect 1.60. Measured daemon synthesis 265um2 / usable core 522.55um2 = 50.7%. W/E pin faces unchanged, density <=2.3/um.
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: PASS: single S clock entry (centre-ish, as ep3), ~250 flops; spread checked at the --cts gate (TT/FF <= 80); io_hold_margin 0.03
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: PASS: static; epoch-anchored outputs on the same edges as qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin (bench cycle-equal); the boot path adds no runtime cycle; reset/halt-relative outputs +1 edge (boot constant / exception path, before any epoch)
